com.vector.cfg.model.sysdesc.api.taskmapping

Enum EEventType

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<EEventType>
      • com.vector.cfg.model.sysdesc.api.taskmapping.EEventType
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<EEventType>

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public enum EEventType
extends java.lang.Enum<EEventType>
    AUTOSAR defines multiple different events which can trigger executable entities. This enumeration represents the type of an IEvent for BSWEvents as well as for RTEEvents.

    (c) Copyright Vector Informatik GmbH. All Rights Reserved.

    • Enum Constant Summary

      Enum Constants 
      Enum Constant and Description
      BACKGROUND
      Events that are executed in background.
      DATA_RECEIVE_ERROR
      Events which are sent when an error concerning the reception of the referenced data element was detected.
      DATA_RECEIVED
      Events which are sent when the referenced data elements are received.
      DATA_SEND_COMPLETED
      Events which are sent when the referenced data elements have been sent or an error occurs.
      EXTERNAL_TRIGGER
      Events raised when the referenced external trigger have been occurred.
      INIT
      Events used for initialization purposes.
      INTERNAL_TRIGGER
      Events raised when the referenced internal trigger have been occurred.
      MODE_ENTRY
      Events which are raised when entering the referenced modes.
      MODE_EXIT
      Events which are raised when leaving the referenced modes.
      MODE_SWITCH_ACK
      Events raised when the referenced modes have been received or an error occurred.
      MODE_TRANSITION
      Events raised on transition of the referenced modes.
      OPERATION_INVOKED
      Events which are sent when the referenced client server operation is invoked.
      SERVER_CALL_RETURNS
      Events which are raised when a server call is finished.
      TIMING
      Events that are sent periodically.
